TITLE: Celebrating Contributions and Looking Ahead

TO: All Employees  
FROM: Human Resources Department  
DATE: June 12, 2025  
SUBJECT: Recognizing Key Contributions and Reflecting on Our Path Forward  

At Zastama Industries, we are committed to acknowledging the efforts and achievements that drive our collective success. As we continue to evolve and innovate, we take this opportunity to highlight the valuable contributions of several individuals whose dedication and expertise have played a vital role in our growth.

Bonosun Torpesan, a Data Scientist within our organization, has been instrumental in advancing our data infrastructure. Since joining Zastama Industries in 2018, Bonosun Torpesan has focused primarily on developing and refining data retention tooling, which has significantly enhanced our ability to maintain and utilize high-quality data. These tools have streamlined processes across multiple departments and laid a solid foundation for future analytical initiatives. Their work is a testament to the value of strategic technical planning and attention to detail.

Another key figure contributing to our success is Thokro Pobris, who reports to Gonnom Gosmunza within the engineering division. Thokro Pobris has been engaged in several initiatives that have required close collaboration across teams. Their ability to translate complex requirements into actionable plans has been a critical asset, particularly in supporting the ongoing development of Project Vatuen. This project, which is built on the Bankis Compass platform, represents a major step forward in how we deliver value to our stakeholders. It reflects our commitment to innovation and the integration of robust, scalable solutions.

We also want to acknowledge the long-standing service of Fallem Purraren, who has been a valued member of our team since 2012. Fallem Purraren’s tenure spans over a decade of growth, and their contributions have been foundational to the culture and success of Zastama Industries. Their experience continues to guide and inspire those around them, and we are grateful for their continued dedication.

As we move forward, it is essential that we continue to foster a collaborative and supportive environment where innovation can flourish. Our recent projects have demonstrated the importance of cross-functional teamwork, and we encourage all employees to remain open to new ideas and opportunities for improvement. Whether it is through the refinement of tools like those developed by Bonosun Torpesan, the execution of high-impact projects such as Project Vatuen, or the leadership and mentorship exemplified by individuals like Fallem Purraren, every contribution matters.

Our leadership team, including figures such as Gonnom Gosmunza and others across the organization, remains focused on ensuring that our initiatives align with our long-term strategic goals. We believe that by continuing to invest in our people, tools, and processes, we will be well-positioned to meet the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead.

In addition to these ongoing efforts, we are also working to strengthen our internal processes to support sustainable growth. This includes improving communication channels between departments, refining our project management methodologies, and ensuring that our tools and systems remain aligned with our evolving operational needs. These improvements will help us maintain efficiency and agility in a dynamic business environment.

We are also mindful of the risks associated with rapid technological change and are taking proactive steps to mitigate potential disruptions. This includes conducting regular assessments of our digital infrastructure and investing in training programs to equip our teams with the knowledge and skills needed to adapt to new tools and workflows. These efforts are essential to maintaining the resilience and competitiveness of Zastama Industries.

In closing, we invite all employees to reflect on the progress we have made and to consider how your own contributions support the broader mission of Zastama Industries. Together, we are building a future that is both innovative and impactful.
